# 1. Imperial Scriptorium & Greek Press (unlocked by Greek Printing Press or Academy Tier 3).
oe_ren_imperial_scriptorium = {
    ability = adm
    icon = pop_promote_action
    allow_multiple = no
    potential = {
        oe_ren_is_empire = yes
        OR = {
            has_variable = oe_ren_press_built
            var:oe_ren_academy_tier ?= 3
        }
    }
    allow = {
        oe_ren_holds_city = yes
    }
    country_modifier = {
        global_institution_growth_modifier = 0.15
        global_books_output_modifier = 0.15
        global_monthly_literacy = 0.03
        clergy_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.04
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        add = { value = 20 }
        scope:actor = {
            if = { limit = { at_war = yes } subtract = { value = 30 } }
        }
    }
}

# 2. Mystras-Constantinople Philosophical Seminar (available while Renaissance debate is active or settled).
oe_ren_philosophical_seminar = {
    ability = dip
    icon = diplomatic_endeavors
    allow_multiple = no
    potential = {
        oe_ren_is_empire = yes
        OR = {
            has_variable = oe_ren_active
            has_variable = oe_ren_done

    allow = {
        stability >= 0

    country_modifier = {
        research_speed_modifier = 0.06
        cultural_influence_modifier = 0.10
        diplomatic_reputation = 0.5
        stability_cost_efficiency = -0.05
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        add = { value = 15 }
        scope:actor = {
            if = { limit = { stability < 15 } subtract = { value = 25 } }
        }
    }
}
